name: Structured Full-Grain Leather Tote
description: A boxy, structured tote bag in vegetable-tanned tan full-grain leather with solid brass hardware and reinforced stitched handles.
materials: Vegetable-tanned tan full-grain leather, solid brass hardware and feet, reinforced stitched handles
primaryColors: Warm tan leather; warm brass-gold hardware
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, logo, wordmark, stamped emblem, or embossed lettering anywhere on the leather, hardware, or a strap keeper; if any tag or label shape is implied, show it strictly blank and unprinted; no props, no hands, except the forearm required for the worn-scale angle. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the boxy silhouette, tan leather tone and grain, brass hardware placement (corner feet, top hardware), and saddle-stitch pattern identical across all four angles.
